      public WellAllocation(String name, double chokeFraction, double liftRate, double oilRate, double gasRate, double waterRate, String bindingConstraint)
      Creates a well allocation entry.
      Parameters:
      name - well name
      chokeFraction - recommended choke opening in [0, 1]
      liftRate - lift-gas rate in Sm3/day
      oilRate - oil rate in Sm3/day
      gasRate - produced-gas rate in Sm3/day
      waterRate - produced-water rate in Sm3/day
      bindingConstraint - the constraint that limited this well
